name: Wrist Extensor Stretch
steps: Extend one arm straight in front of you at chest height with your elbow locked and palm facing down.
Flex your wrist so your fingers point straight down toward the floor.
Use your opposite hand to draw the back of your hand gently toward your body until the top of your forearm stretches comfortably.
Hold steadily while relaxing your shoulders for the target duration, then release gently and switch arms.
tips: Keep your elbow completely straight throughout the hold to stretch across the full forearm extensor muscles.
Pull gently across the back of your hand rather than yanking sharply on individual fingers.
